roster_selection: all metadata candidates outside every basin present in named earlier NVE raw and confirmation files, at most one per basin chosen by largest reported complete-year field then station ID; no temperature values used
caveats: not a formal preregistration; potential other prior records and network/climatic dependence remain unchecked; field meaning and physical subdaily completeness need verification
chart_endpoint: provider chart service used by public Seriekart; requests use no key
evaluation: reference qualification and scoring require actual data and documented per-observation QC; a chart response alone is insufficient
